lines.en: Bruno, I’d rather stay home tonight than go to that noisy party. Would you rather come over for a film?
lines.pt: Bruno, prefiro ficar em casa hoje à noite a ir àquela festa barulhenta. Você prefere vir aqui ver um filme?

lines.en: I’d rather not go out either. I’d rather watch something relaxing than spend two hours in traffic.
lines.pt: Também prefiro não sair. Prefiro ver algo relaxante a passar duas horas no trânsito.

lines.en: Great. Would you rather order pizza or cook? I’d rather cook, but only if you help me.
lines.pt: Ótimo. Você prefere pedir pizza ou cozinhar? Eu prefiro cozinhar, mas só se você me ajudar.

lines.en: I’d rather order, to be honest. I’d rather not cook after a long day, and I’d rather save my energy.
lines.pt: Prefiro pedir, para ser sincera. Prefiro não cozinhar depois de um dia longo, e prefiro poupar minha energia.

lines.en: Fair enough. Would you rather watch a comedy or a thriller? I’d rather not see anything too violent.
lines.pt: Justo. Você prefere ver uma comédia ou um thriller? Eu prefiro não ver nada muito violento.

lines.en: A comedy, please. I’d rather laugh than feel nervous before bed, and I’d rather sit on the sofa than the floor.
lines.pt: Uma comédia, por favor. Prefiro rir a ficar nervosa antes de dormir, e prefiro sentar no sofá a sentar no chão.

lines.en: Deal. My flat is small, but I’d rather live here than in a big house far from the city centre.
lines.pt: Combinado. Meu apartamento é pequeno, mas prefiro morar aqui a morar numa casa grande longe do centro.

lines.en: I understand. I’d rather pay less rent and walk to work than own a car and sit in a traffic jam.
lines.pt: Entendo. Prefiro pagar menos aluguel e ir a pé ao trabalho a ter carro e ficar num engarrafamento.

lines.en: Exactly. Would you rather live by the sea or in the middle of the city, if you could choose?
lines.pt: Exato. Você preferiria morar à beira-mar ou no meio da cidade, se pudesse escolher?

lines.en: Honestly, I’d rather live by the sea. I’d rather have a quiet beach than a noisy nightclub.
lines.pt: Sinceramente, prefiro morar à beira-mar. Prefiro uma praia tranquila a uma balada barulhenta.

lines.en: Then we agree. I’d rather stay in tonight and plan a weekend at the beach instead!
lines.pt: Então concordamos. Prefiro ficar em casa hoje e planejar um fim de semana na praia!

facts.label: Would rather
facts.sub: Preferência: I’d rather stay home. Negativa: I’d rather not go. Comparação: I’d rather walk than drive. Pergunta: Would you rather…?

facts.label: Preferir
facts.sub: Use would rather + verbo base para dizer o que você prefere: I’d rather stay home tonight. Não use to depois de rather. Em português: “eu preferiria / prefiro”.

facts.label: Would rather not
facts.sub: Para recusar com educação: I’d rather not go. Coloque not depois de rather. Boa resposta a convites: Thanks, but I’d rather not.

items.s: Would rather is followed by the base form of the verb.

answers: Would rather is followed by the base form of the verb. → Verdadeiro (Yes.)
We say “I’d rather to stay home”. → Falso (We say I’d rather stay home.)
The negative is “I’d rather not go”. → Verdadeiro (Yes.)

pages.title: A quiet Friday night · 1/3
paragraphs: It is Friday evening in Adelaide. Boris is tired after a long week. His friend Luisa has an invitation to a party. Neither of them feels like going out. They talk about food, films and the city. Everyone has different preferences.

“Luisa, I’d rather stay home tonight than go to that noisy party. Would you rather come over for a film?” says Boris. “I’d rather not go out either. I’d rather watch something relaxing than spend two hours in traffic.” says Luisa. “Great. Would you rather order pizza or cook? I’d rather cook, but only if you help me.” says Boris.
